items.title: David Friesen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 24, 2024
items.q: To Albert Ayler I guess and Coltrane and Miles, and Ravi Shankar. Those were the people I listened to a lot.

ctx.x: Okay so when you were, let’s see, in your twenties this might have been a pop hit. Anyway, that was “My Girl” by the Temptations. Okay how about this one?

I didn’t listen a lot to those kind of things. What did I listen to in my twenties? To Albert Ayler I guess and Coltrane and Miles, and Ravi Shankar. Those were the people I listened to a lot. I didn’t listen to Bob Dylan.
